segments.text:
Think how unstable and changeable all these
things are. What you glory in to day, may
be none of yours to morrow, Prov. 23. 5. Riches
make themselves wings, and flee away as an Eagle
towards Heaven. As the Wings of a Fowl grow
out of the substance of its body, so the cause
of the Creatures transitoriness is in it self:
It's subjected to vanity, and that vanity, like
Wings, carries it away: they are but fading
flowers, James, 1. 10.
